outcome: Fetal cardiac dimensions (transverse and longitudinal diameters and areas of the whole heart, atria, ventricles)
cohort: The study included 602 low-risk singleton pregnancies undergoing standardized fetal echocardiography.
finding: Standardized nomograms for fetal cardiac morphometric parameters were constructed, showing a progressive increase in all dimensions with gestational age.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken from 18 to 41 weeks of gestation.
